verdict.rationale: Luma is a generative video/image SaaS and API platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents REST endpoints, SDKs, llms.txt and per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions, but never mentions an MCP server. Those items are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so with no evidence of an MCP server the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
